summary.en: Probability assigns each outcome a number between 0 and 1; the rules for combining events depend on whether they are mutually exclusive and whether they are independent, which are different questions with different tests.
summary.et: Tõenäosus omistab igale tulemile arvu vahemikus 0 kuni 1; sündmuste ühendamise reeglid sõltuvad sellest, kas need on teineteist välistavad ja kas need on sõltumatud — need on eri küsimused eri kontrollidega.
